summary: This file contains only a static dictionary (KHOT_EMBEDDINGS) mapping atomic numbers 1-100 to 92-dimensional k-hot binary vectors representing elemental properties from the CGCNN paper. There are no functions, classes, or callable APIs. No tool-use examples apply.
KHOT_EMBEDDINGS_lookup: look up the 92-dimensional k-hot binary embedding vector for a given atomic number (1-100) from the KHOT_EMBEDDINGS dictionary
KHOT_EMBEDDINGS_iterate: iterate over all 100 elemental k-hot embeddings in the KHOT_EMBEDDINGS dictionary by atomic number
KHOT_EMBEDDINGS_check_dimension: check that each k-hot embedding vector in KHOT_EMBEDDINGS has exactly 92 dimensions
KHOT_EMBEDDINGS_count_ones: count the number of set bits (ones) in a specific element's k-hot embedding vector from KHOT_EMBEDDINGS
KHOT_EMBEDDINGS_convert_tensor: convert the KHOT_EMBEDDINGS dictionary values into a PyTorch tensor for use in graph neural network models
